# AirfareWatchdog

> AirfareWatchdog helps travelers find cheap flights, compare airline fares, and track price alerts across major carriers.

AirfareWatchdog is a flight comparison and deal-finding platform with over 20 years of expertise in airfare pricing. The site combines flight search tools, price monitoring, and travel guides to help users save money on airline tickets while understanding airline fees, policies, and travel hacks.

## Key Topics

- Flight deals
- Cheap flights
- Airfare comparison
- Price alerts
- Airline tickets
- Baggage fees
- Flight pricing
- Economy class
- Fare tracking
- American Airlines
- Delta
- United Airlines
- Caribbean destinations
- Travel guides
- Airline hubs

## Core Platform

- [Cheap Flights & Airline Tickets [Compare Flight Deals]](https://www.airfarewatchdog.com): AirfareWatchdog homepage for flight search, price alerts, and cheap flight deals
- [About AirfareWatchdog](https://www.airfarewatchdog.com/about-us): About AirfareWatchdog: company mission and 20+ years of airfare expertise
- [Pricing](https://www.airfarewatchdog.com/pricing): AirfareWatchdog subscription plans and pricing for flight monitoring

## Airline Fees & Policies

- [Guide to Baggage Fees](https://www.airfarewatchdog.com/blog/baggage-fees): Comprehensive guide comparing baggage fees across major airlines
- [The Ultimate Guide to In-Flight Drink & Snack Prices](https://www.airfarewatchdog.com/blog/3802275/in-flight-drink-snack-prices): Guide to U.S. domestic in-flight drink and snack prices by airline
- [5 Things to Know About American Airlines' New 'Main Plus' Economy Fare](https://www.airfarewatchdog.com/blog/50193636/5-things-to-know-about-american-airlines-new-main-plus-economy-fare): Analysis of American Airlines Main Plus economy fare benefits and value

## Flight Strategy & Optimization

- [Airline Hub Guide: Which U.S. Cities Are Major Hubs and Why It Matters](https://www.airfarewatchdog.com/blog/50066526/airline-hub-guide-which-u-s-cities-are-major-hubs-and-why-it-matters): Guide to U.S. airline hubs and how hub locations affect flight prices
- [5 Hacks for Maximum Airplane Seat Comfort](https://www.airfarewatchdog.com/blog/50081324/5-hacks-for-maximum-airplane-seat-comfort): Travel tips for airplane seat comfort using pillows and accessories

## Travel Trivia & Entertainment

- [15 Weird Airport Codes and How They Came to Be](https://www.airfarewatchdog.com/blog/44258497/15-weird-airport-codes-and-how-they-came-to-be): Travel trivia about unusual IATA airport codes and their origins
- [15 of the Most Hilarious TripAdvisor Reviews of All Time](https://www.airfarewatchdog.com/blog/24343464/15-of-the-most-hilarious-tripadvisor-reviews-of-all-time-ever): Entertainment article featuring funny TripAdvisor reviews of landmarks
